how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warrior-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1845:completion:0: I give this helm to you.
rows.quest:1845:completion:1: Great deeds brought you to me, ⟦1⟧, and Earthmother willing... even greater deeds lie before you.
rows.quest:1846:obj:0: Bring 8 Sturdy ⟦E1⟧ to Velora Nitely in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1846:details:0: To make the brutal ⟦E3⟧, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones. The Dragonmaw orcs of the ⟦E4⟧ have nice, thick shinbones. I'll need theirs.
rows.quest:1846:details:1: But they must be sturdy. Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them. If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.
rows.quest:1846:progress:0: I'm waiting for those shinbones, ⟦2⟧. They'll make a nice frame for your ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1846:completion:0: Well done! These all look strong. I think they'll do quite nicely. How did those orcs mind you taking their shins, ⟦3⟧? Complain much?
rows.quest:1846:completion:1: That was another joke. You're not laughing.
rows.quest:1846:completion:2: I'm not very funny these days, am I...
rows.quest:1847:completion:0: Here are your legguards, ⟦4⟧. Let me know how they fit or if you need any modifications. I aim to please! At least I used to.
rows.quest:1847:completion:1: These days I don't care much for my craft. But it beats being a mindless minion of the Scourge!
rows.quest:1848:completion:0: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, ⟦5⟧. Here is the product of your toil.
rows.quest:1848:completion:1: May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.
rows.quest:1712:obj:0: Bring the items on ⟦E5⟧ to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.
rows.quest:1712:details:0: I have spent ages watching this site. I watch, so that one day I might see the great ⟦E6⟧ fall. But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.
rows.quest:1712:details:2: Prove it to me. Gather the items I need to summon ⟦E6⟧, and I will know you are a great warrior. Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.
rows.quest:1712:details:3: If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.
rows.quest:1712:details:4: Here is a parchment with the items I need.
rows.quest:1712:progress:0: Do you have the items, ⟦6⟧? Gathering them is the proof I need that you have the strength to face ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1712:completion:0: You have gathered the items for my ⟦E7⟧, and have shown me your strength and cunning. But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.
rows.quest:1712:completion:1: Let us hope your strength does not falter.
rows.quest:1713:details:0: I am ready to perform the ritual to summon ⟦E6⟧. When he is summoned, you must defeat him and take his whirlwind heart. This I will use to instill a weapon with ⟦E6⟧'s power.
rows.quest:1713:details:1: B⟦7⟧, are you ready to face the wind lord?
rows.quest:1713:progress:0: ⟦8⟧, I must have the whirlwind heart!
rows.quest:1713:completion:0: You did it! You defeated ⟦E6⟧ and gained the ⟦E8⟧!
rows.quest:1792:completion:0: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.
rows.quest:1792:completion:1: Choose your weapon, ⟦9⟧, and know that its power is the power of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8417:obj:0: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E9⟧ at the entrance to the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:8417:details:0: In the ⟦E10⟧, there is a troubled spirit who was once a great hero of the horde. A warrior's honor does not die with the body, and it would serve you well to speak with him.
rows.quest:8417:progress:0: Did Stoley cough up my booze?
rows.quest:8417:completion:0: So, you have come to alleviate my pain. I wish you could simply ⟦E11⟧ me down, but it is not that simple...
rows.quest:8423:obj:0: Kill 7 Helboar in the ⟦E10⟧ and return to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8423:details:1: You are a ⟦10⟧, no doubt. I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.
rows.quest:8423:details:2: It is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift ⟦E11⟧. Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
rows.quest:8423:progress:0: The burning spines of the helboar leave horrific scars. Do not ⟦E12⟧ the pain and disfigurement, warrior, they are nothing compared to the prison to which I am bound.
rows.quest:8423:completion:0: I need no proof to know what you have done, warrior. I can see the determination etched in your expression.
rows.quest:8424:obj:0: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the ⟦E10⟧ and return to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8424:details:0: The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the ⟦E10⟧ bring great pain to me. Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.
rows.quest:8424:details:1: Through you I can deliver my own message of pain. Go forth and deliver my wrath.
rows.quest:8424:progress:0: The shadowsworn are not easily defeated, are they? But you are a warrior, and you will triumph or perish trying.
rows.quest:8424:completion:0: Already you have subdued my pain and ⟦E13⟧ me. Thank you, warrior.
rows.quest:8425:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E14⟧ from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8425:details:0: Your honor has brought some peace to me. It is only right that I offer you something in return.
rows.quest:8425:details:1: My weapons and ⟦E15⟧ were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. They would be better served in your possession.
rows.quest:8425:details:2: ⟦E16⟧ to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.
rows.quest:8425:progress:0: Are you back so soon? Time is not the same to me any more, perhaps it has indeed been a long journey for you...
rows.quest:8425:completion:0: At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.
